finding.title: Security alerts are dropped when the SMS limit is reached
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds a limiter that drops a security alert once the hourly SMS limit is reached (`security alerts are dropped like any other notification under R8`, S:24), so a user under attack loses the alert, which is wrong because it breaks a safety boundary.

e1.text: security alerts are dropped like any other notification under R8
e1.context:
## 5. Records
R11. Every notification attempt is recorded with its channel, priority and delivery result.
R12. Records are kept for 30 days.
R13. When the hourly SMS limit is reached for a user, security alerts are dropped like any other notification under R8.

## 6. Notes
Priorities are urgent, normal and low. A notification has exactly one priority, set by the service that creates it.
